batchEvents.detail: Small approval batch granted by workstation for Calculator: at most 12 mutating actions within 2 min; covers Bring its window forward, Press one of its buttons, Open its app. It ends at the limit, at expiry, on Stop, on a target mismatch, or with the mission.
